facts.related_party_note: All contracts and arrangements entered into with related parties during the financial year were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. The Company has adopted a Related Party Transactions Policy approved by the Board. Transactions are placed before the Audit Committee for review and approval, with omnibus approval for repetitive transactions and quarterly disclosures.
